run_prepare_step: run the prepare step to merge sharded Wikipedia pickle files and extract unique anchors
run_solve_step: run the solve step to map Wikipedia anchors to Wikidata IDs using language lookup tables
run_fill_step: run the fill step to enrich Wikipedia pages with resolved Wikidata IDs for each anchor
review_clean_anchor_lang: review the clean_anchor_lang function that recursively strips language prefixes from URL-encoded Wikipedia anchors
build_anchor_preprocessing_pipeline: build a three-step pipeline to prepare, solve, and fill Wikipedia anchor data with Wikidata mappings
